name: print-social-chat-and-sticker-tray-cake-post-on-macro-photo
title: Message thread with cake stickers in an emoji tray over a macro layer-cake photograph
whatItIs: A macro photo of cream and sponge layers with a white iMessage-style panel: a grey bubble asking for a pretty and delicious cake, a reply in the input with orange highlighted words 'pretty', 'delicious' and 'party', a search bar and a sticker tray of eighteen cut-out cakes, with a small blue logo at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Witty and mouth-watering; the sticker tray turns a cake menu into emoji.
techniques: Parody a messaging app with a sticker tray as the product grid.
Highlight key words in orange within the reply.
Use a macro food photo as the backdrop.
Keep the panel white so cutouts pop.

vocabulary.definition: A grid of stickers like a keyboard panel.
Key words coloured in a reply.
An extreme close-up photo behind a panel.
